onboardedEditors.biography: Professor Prashant Kumar is the Professor and Chair in Air Quality and Health at the University of Surrey, where he is the Founding Director of the Global Centre for Clean Air Research (GCARE) and Founding Co-Director of the Institute for Sustainability. He holds a PhD from the University of Cambridge and has been consistently named in the top 1% of Global Highly Cited Researchers. Winner of the 2023 Haagen-Smit Prize and Clean Air Award.

onboardedEditors.biography: Professor Sanna Järvelä is Professor in the Department of Educational Sciences and the Learning and Educational Technology (LET) research unit at the University of Oulu, Finland. Her research centers on self-regulated learning, socially shared regulation in learning, and multimodal learning analytics. She is an elected member of the Finnish Academy of Science and Letters.
